topic: Virtual sensor data ingestion and impact
summary_markdown:
Starting July 1st, sessions for virtual sensors will be added to the database according to a mapping provided by someone. To maintain unique identifiers, the `device_id` on virtual sensors will be calculated as `abs(source.device_id - facility_num)`. Otherwise, the traffic will simply be a copy of the corresponding source sensor's traffic.

It was noted that the volume of virtual traffic will now exceed the physical traffic volume.
